FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 275
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Dan Roberts
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/02/2025
Senate Bill 275 as introduced would exempt mobile food vendors from having to obtain
additional licenses, permits, or other permissions, in jurisdictions a mobile food vendor
temporarily operates. This could decrease county and municipality general funds by an
undetermined amount dependent on the number of licenses, permits, or other permissions no
longer required for mobile food vendor to operate in jurisdictions outside of the food vendor's
established commissary location.
